regime: Partial bounce after a Fed-hike scare
takeaway: Overnight, gold won back a small part of Tuesday's drop (about +0.6% near $4,056) while silver bounced about 2.7%, pulling the gold/silver ratio down to about 77. Yields are frozen at Tuesday's high levels (10-year near 5%, 2-year 4.74%) because the bond market is shut for Veterans Day, so the 'Fed hike being priced' pattern from Tuesday still stands. Stock futures point higher and Brent is back near $93 after tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.
